main_text.p: tetinit. Et in concione, Simplicius est quem prouincia nostra Metropolitanum ciuitati vestræ summum Sacerdotem, fieri debere pronuncio. epist. 6. Burdegala, Petrogorij, Rutheni, Lemouices, Gabalitani, Heluani, Vasates Conuena, Aus-

{...} fragio, & de Sacerdotum antiquorum & bonorum virorum collegio. Hæc de Cornelij Episcopi Romani electione. Et vt sciamus eodem ordine, eadem solennitate creari solitum Carthaginensem, audiamus ipsius Cypriani electionem.
main_text.head: CAP. X.
De creatione Episcoporum.
main_text.p: I Si Ecclesiæ totius vnus esset Monarcha: ergo singuli Episcopi crearentur ab vnico illo.
main_text.head: CAP. XI.
Ab vno homine regi non posse vniuersas Ecclesias.
main_text.p: I Si Ecclesiæ regimen esset Monarchicum, ergo vnicus homo posset suf- ficere regendis omnib. per totum orbem terrarum Ecclesiis.

page.notes: Text is heavily worn and partly illegible in the scan; the transcription above is partial, covering the opening lines of each column only. Greek passages and the long columns of text could not be reliably read and should be checked against the original. Running head reads as printed; the page carries no marginal notes.
